title: Vaso's Beach House | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Spacious Home in Highland Parks* Covered Porch, Balcony, and Backyard Patio * 4 Cruiser Bikes * 2 Living Areas* Blue Mountain Beach Access- 1.3 miles (parking, restrooms, and seasonal lifeguards)* Pool w/Waterf
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Spacious Home in Highland Parks* Covered Porch, Balcony, and Backyard Patio * 4 Cruiser Bikes * 2 Living Areas* Blue Mountain Beach Access- 1.3 miles (parking, restrooms, and seasonal lifeguards)* Pool w/Waterfall (Seasonally heated starting in March), Hot Tub, Gazebo, Community Grilling Area, 360-observation Tower* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Close by Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center* Under 1 mile to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions.*Vaso's Beach House is a 4 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom home in Highland Parks neighborhood on the beautiful scenic 30A. Enjoy your morning cup of coffee on the covered porch or balcony then chase the sunset in the evening on the back patio! Come fall in love with this beach home with its cozy, chic décor, crown molding throughout, raised ceilings, and beautiful hardwood floors. The gorgeous kitchen boasts a large island perfect for entertaining with stainless steel appliances and granite counters. The open-concept living area is great for the whole family, with a flat-screen TV and a dining table separating the large kitchen island. With a king bed in the master suite, a queen bed in two of the guest rooms, and a queen-over-queen bunkbed, twin-over-queen bunk bed, and a twin trundle in the 3rd guest bedroom, this lovely home sleeps up to 12 guests comfortably. Hop on the 4 provided bikes and head to the beach, then spend the day by the sparkling Highland Parks pool that features a waterfall, gazebo, and 360-observation town! Come make Vaso's Beach House your family beach vacation tradition!Bed Setup:First Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed w/ensuite bathroomSecond Floor:Guest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: One Queen-over-Queen bunkbed, one Twin-over-Queen Bunkbed, and a Twin Trundle* This home can sleep 14 guests but max occupancy per HOA is 12 guests only**Parking is only available for 2 vehicles in the home's designated paved driveway. Street parking is not allowed. Violations are strictly enforced by the HOA.*Highland Parks is the newest neighborhood in Blue Mountain Beach featuring a fantastic neighborhood pool with a waterfall, hot tub, gazebo, fire pit, snack bar, and observation tower. The area is the highest point in South Walton County and is surrounded by great eateries and local eclectic shops. From the 4-story observation tower, you can see the Gulf, the bay, and miles along the coast to Seaside and Sandestin in either direction. Highland Parks is perfectly situated between Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center on Hwy 30A! Enjoy dining at local favorites The Perfect Pig, Red Door, Local Catch, or Basmati's. Check out the local art scene at Justin Gaffery’s art gallery.AREA ATTRACTIONS: Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater, and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous, There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
